goal: Implements the BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules on regtest only, leaving mainnet activation for later
Gives the project a concrete, tested artifact to review known consensus-level defects like timewarp and unbounded sigops
Benefits the network's long-term security by letting developers evaluate a fix without committing to activation yet
reviewability: Ready for review now, author has rebased repeatedly and addressed all comments as recently as 2026-09-13
CI is clean and no material request is left unanswered
agreement: Strong concept support from seven reviewers with no unresolved objections (dergoegge, fanquake, polespinasa, theStack, hsjoberg, fjahr, stickies-v)
Nonblocking objection: DoS-cost asymmetry in sigops accounting discussed but treated as an accepted tradeoff (ariard)
Nonblocking objection: TX_CONSENSUS tagging of a policy-origin check, author explained rationale and added a comment (polespinasa)
Nits raised and either implemented or declined with accepted rationale, no standing pushback

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it implements new consensus rules fixing known timewarp, Murch-Zawy, and sigops DoS exploits
Affects core security and correctness of the network regardless of when or whether mainnet activation happens
High leverage since this is the substantive code the project needs to review to reach an activation decision

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it closes a policy bypass by making the sigops check consensus-critical instead of policy-only
Strengthens a DoS defense that mempool policy exists to provide, per extensive discussion
Benefit is real but narrower in scope than the core validation change

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because most of the substantive miner-side enforcement already merged separately as #35949
Remaining changes here are just naming and comment consistency updates
Low independent leverage on its own

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it only adds a small, uncontroversial deployment-status entry to existing RPC output
No external consumer demand cited for this exposure
Marginal relative to the PR's core purpose

categories.name: docs
why: P4 because it is a single-line addition documenting BIP 54 support
Useful for discoverability but minimal in scope
Marginal relative to the PR's overall size and purpose
